brief: 6 kitchen tools that replaced 30 — minimalist home cook edition.

slots.headline: 6 Tools That Replaced 30?
slots.subtitle: The minimalist home cook’s guide to a clutter-free kitchen.

slots.title: One Knife, Every Cut
slots.body: A sharp chef’s knife handles slicing, dicing, and mincing without the block full of blades. Skip the paring, bread, and utility knives. This one blade does it all with precision and control.

slots.title: One Pan, Endless Meals
slots.body: Sear, bake, roast, and fry in a single cast iron skillet. It replaces non-stick pans, grill pans, and baking dishes. From stovetop to oven, it earns its shelf space daily.

slots.title: Dutch Oven, Many Jobs
slots.body: Simmer soups, braise meat, bake bread, and serve straight to the table. It stands in for a slow cooker, stock pot, and roasting pan. Heavy, timeless, and impossibly versatile.

slots.title: Grate, Slice, Shred, Zest
slots.body: Four sides replace the mandoline, zester, microplane, and food processor shredding disk. Cheese, vegetables, and citrus all meet one stainless steel tower. Less clutter, same crisp results.

slots.title: Stick Blender, Big Jobs
slots.body: Puree soups, whip cream, and blend smoothies directly in the container. It eliminates the countertop blender, food processor, and hand mixer. Store it in a drawer and forget the cord clutter.

slots.title: Shears Cut The Clutter
slots.body: Snip herbs, spatchcock chicken, open packages, and trim pastry with one strong pair. They replace multiple gadgets and single-task scissors. Keep them handy and reach for them constantly.

slots.headline: Declutter Your Kitchen Now
slots.body: Trade gadget overload for calm, purposeful cooking. Follow for more minimalist home tips.
